# StoreAPI

> Competitor App Store / Play reviews as JSON. $19/mo.

Public US and UK App Store and Google Play listings, reviews, and keyword search. Independent, not Apple or Google. Not a Sensor Tower replacement of their estimates.

Skill: US/UK only; no download estimates; do not write metadata. A fabricated review is a Sev-0.

SEO: `app store review api`, `google play reviews api`, `sensor tower alternative`, Sensor Tower pricing pages.

## URLs

- REST: https://api.storeapi.dev
- MCP Streamable HTTP: https://mcp.storeapi.dev/mcp
- This file: /llms.txt
- Server card: /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## Auth

```
Authorization: Bearer st_live_...
Authorization: Bearer st_test_...
```

Same key space for REST and MCP. No scopes. `st_test_*` uses recorded fixtures and never hits live App Store or Play.

## MCP tools

### get_app

Maps to `GET /v1/apps/{store}/{id}`. **1 credit** on success.

Arguments: `store` (`ios` | `play`) and `id` required; optional `country` (`US` default, `GB` allowed).

`data` is the unified listing (name, developer, rating, price, description, version). Never invent download, revenue, or estimate fields.

### list_reviews

Maps to `GET /v1/apps/{store}/{id}/reviews`. **1 credit per page**, including empty pages.

Arguments: `store` and `id` required; optional `country` (`US` default, `GB` allowed); optional `page` (1-based, default 1).

Empty page is `{ reviews: [], hasMore: false }`, never 404. Stars are integers 1–5. Never invent a review.

### keyword_search

Maps to `GET /v1/search`. **1 credit per page**, including empty pages.

Arguments: `store` and `q` required; optional `country` (`US` default, `GB` allowed); optional `page` (1-based, default 1).

Each hit is `id` + `name` only. Never invent ranks, downloads, or revenue.

## When not to call

- Countries other than US and UK — expect `country_unsupported`, 0 credits.
- Writing listing metadata or posting a review — read-only public pages.
- Download counts, revenue, or Sensor Tower-style estimates — we never ship those fields.
- CN storefronts — out of scope.
- Implying we are Apple, Google, or a Sensor Tower estimates replacement — independent public index.

## Errors

Same envelope as REST. `creditsCharged` is always 0 on error. Tool failures set `isError: true` and keep the REST error body in `structuredContent`.

| code | HTTP | retryable |
|---|---|---|
| invalid_request | 400 | no |
| unauthorized | 401 | no |
| payment_required | 402 | no |
| app_not_found | 404 | no |
| store_unsupported | 422 | no |
| country_unsupported | 422 | no |
| not_implemented | 501 | no |
| rate_limited | 429 | yes |
| upstream_blocked | 503 | yes |
| internal | 500 | yes |

A store block or empty upstream is `upstream_blocked` and costs **0 credits**. Never invent listing fields or review rows.

## Credits

Free: 100 once. Monthly $19 / 3,000. Listing 1. Reviews 1 / page. Search 1 / page. Failures cost 0.
